learning_outcomes.text: Describe and differentiate the most important machining and non-machining manufacturing processes according to DIN 8580.
Analyze the influence of essential process parameters on component quality, dimensional accuracy, surface finish, economic efficiency, and material properties.
Select suitable manufacturing processes for simple industrial applications and technically justify the selection.
Explain the relationships between design, production planning, machine tool, and manufacturing process.
Assess the effects of selected manufacturing processes on material properties and component behavior.
Transfer manufacturing technology problems to comparable industrial applications.
Consider aspects of sustainability, especially energy consumption, resource use, and sustainable production, when evaluating manufacturing processes.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to industrial manufacturing processes according to DIN 8580
Sustainability: Introduction and energy consumption / efficiency
assessment_rules: The written exam is 90 minutes long. Permitted materials specified by the lecturer may be used. A bonus system is in place where tasks can be assigned during the course, leading to bonus points for the exam performance based on the quality of work. The maximum crediting of bonus points follows the APO regulations.
